subject: Bayesian Model Averaging for logistic regression in INLA

messages.author: 134fd851978f2940
messages.subject: Bayesian Model Averaging for logistic regression in INLA
parts: I am trying to do model averaging for logistic regression. Can anyone please inform me how to do it in INLA? I've read about INLABMA, but did not get the hang of it. to my best understanding, it is for spatial model, while my case is really 'just standard' logistic regression with many variables. Thank you.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Bayesian Model Averaging for logistic regression in INLA
parts:
On Sun, 2016-11-06 at 03:25 -0800, zarkov qrygen wrote:
> I am trying to do model averaging for logistic regression. Can anyone
> please inform me how to do it in INLA? I've read about INLABMA, but
> did not get the hang of it. to my best understanding, it is for
> spatial model, while my case is really 'just standard' logistic
> regression with many variables. Thank you.

Hi

you have to run each model separately, and do the weighting using the
computed (log) marginal likelihood combined with your prior. The only
issue, is that you may need a function to compute marginals from a
mixture of marginals. 

H

--
Håvard Rue
he...@r-inla.org
